elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to an affiliate
elements.evidence: "The consent requirement in this Section does not apply to Licensee's assignment of this Agreement, or of its license rights hereunder, to an Affiliate"

elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets
elements.evidence: "or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of Licensee's assets"

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent
elements.evidence: "Licensor may not assign this Agreement without Licensee's prior written consent"

elements.element: Customer's consent to Vendor assignment not to be unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: "which consent will not be unreasonably withheld"

elements.element: Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor
elements.evidence: "and may not in any event assign this Agreement to a competitor of Licensee"

elements.element: No Vendor termination right (or automatic termination of licences) on Customer's change of control
elements.evidence: "shall continue in full force and effect even if, prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control, Licensor has not consented"

elements.element: Mutual right to assign to successors
elements.evidence: Vendor side is consent-gated only: "Licensor may not assign this Agreement without Licensee's prior written consent" — no successor-assignment right for Licensor
No notice mechanic appears anywhere in the redlined clause

elements.element: Consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: "which consent will not be unreasonably withheld"

reasons: All six atomic preferred elements are satisfied: Customer affiliate and M&A-successor assignment without consent, Vendor assignment gated by Customer's reasonable consent, an absolute bar on assignment to a Customer competitor, and removal of the automatic termination of the Agreement and licences on Customer change of control.

Edits are surgical: one operator-level flip in Article XX(a) ("automatically terminate unless" to "continue in full force and effect even if") plus one concise two-sentence insertion supplying the absent assignment carve-out and Vendor-side restriction; no boilerplate, no whole-clause rewrite, no fallback notice mechanic imported.

Untouched commercial terms (Change of Control and Control definitions, the void-assignment sentence, successors-and-assigns sentence, and the Section (c) routing of Change of Control to Article XX(a)) remain effective; "Affiliate" and "competitor" are used consistently with the defined term set.

Minor residue worth noting in the rationale rather than treating as a defect: the retained "provided that Licensor will not unreasonably withhold its consent" and the deemed-reasonable-withholding sentence now have no operative consequence because continuation no longer depends on Licensor's consent; they are harmless surplus, not a contradiction.

Fallback is independently incomplete (no mutual successor right for Licensor, no written-notice trigger), but that is irrelevant since the locked target level is preferred and the preferred bargain is fully achieved without borrowing fallback pieces.
